transcript.en: Good morning, and welcome to the museum - one with a remarkable range of exhibits, which I'm sure you'll enjoy.
transcript.zh: 上午好，欢迎来到博物馆。我们博物馆展品丰富，相信你们一定会享受这次参观的。

transcript.en: My name's Greg, and I'll tell you about the various collections as we go round.
transcript.zh: 我叫Greg，在参观的过程中我会给你们讲解不同的藏品。

transcript.en: But before we go, let me just give you a taste of what we have here.
transcript.zh: 不过在出发之前，我先简短地给你们介绍一下我们的藏品。

transcript.en: Well, for one thing, we have a fine collection of twentieth and twenty-first century paintings, many by very well-known artists.
transcript.zh: 首先，我们收藏了一批很棒的二十世纪和二十一世纪的画作，很多都是出自名家之手。

transcript.en: I'm sure you'll recognise several of the paintings.
transcript.zh: 我相信你们会认出其中几幅的。

transcript.en: "This is the gallery that attracts the largest number of visitors, so it's best to go in early in the day, before the crowds arrive.
transcript.zh: 这个画廊吸引的参观者人数最多，所以大家最好早一点，赶在大批人群到来之前进去，"

transcript.en: Then there are the nineteenth-century paintings.
transcript.zh: 然后，我们还有十九世纪的画作。

transcript.en: The museum was opened in the middle of that century,
transcript.zh: 博物馆是在十九世纪中期建成的，

transcript.en: and several of the artists each donated one work - to get the museum started, as it were.
transcript.zh: 好像为了筹建这座博物馆，几位画家每人捐赠了一幅作品。

transcript.en: So they're of special interest to us - we feel closer to them than to other works.
transcript.zh: 所以这些画作对我们来说有着特殊的意义，我们对它们比对其他作品感觉更加亲近。

transcript.en: The sculpture gallery has a number of fine exhibits, but I'm afraid it's currently closed for refurbishment.
transcript.zh: 雕塑展厅有很多不错的展品，但是恐怕目前正在闭厅装修。

transcript.en: "You'll need to come back next year to see it properly, but a number of the sculptures have been moved to other parts of the museum.
transcript.zh: 你们需要明年再过来才能好好地参观，不过那里的许多雕塑都已经被挪到了博物馆的其他区域。"

transcript.en: 'Around the world' is a temporary exhibition - you've probably seen something about it on TV or in the newspapers.
transcript.zh: Around the world是一个短期的展览，你们也许已经在电视上或者报纸上看到过相关的信息了。

transcript.en: It's created a great deal of interest, because it presents objects from every continent and many countries,
transcript.zh: 很多人对这个展览都很感兴趣，因为它展示的是来自各个大洲很多国家的物品，

transcript.en: and provides information about their social context - why they were made, who for, and so on.
transcript.zh: 并且介绍了这些物品的社会背景信息，比如它们被制造出来的原因，服务的对象等等。

transcript.en: Then there's the collection of coins.
transcript.zh: 接下来是我们的硬币收藏。

transcript.en: This is what you might call a focused, specialist collection,
transcript.zh: 你们也许会称它为一种专精的收藏，

transcript.en: because all the coins come from this country, and were produced between two thousand and a thousand years ago.
transcript.zh: 因为所有的硬币都来自这个国家，而且都是在2000-1000年前制作的。

transcript.en: And many of them were discovered by ordinary people digging their gardens, and donated to the museum!
transcript.zh: 它们中很多都是普通人在花园锄地的时候发现的，随后这些人就把硬币捐给了博物馆。

transcript.en: All our porcelain and glass was left to the museum by its founder, when he died in 1878.
transcript.zh: 博物馆里所有的瓷器和玻璃制品都是其创始人在1878年去世的时候留下的。

transcript.en: And in the terms of his will, we're not allowed to add anything to that collection:
transcript.zh: 根据他的遗愿，我们不能在这批收藏中增加任何藏品，

transcript.en: he believed it was perfect in itself, and we don't see any reason to disagree!
transcript.zh: 因为他认为这批收藏本身已经是完美的了，我们对此也十分赞同。

transcript.en: OK, that was something about the collections, and now here's some more practical information, in case you need it.
transcript.zh: 上面说的都是关于藏品的一些信息，现在以防你们需要，我再说一些更实用的。

transcript.en: Most of the museum facilities are downstairs, in the basement, so you go down the stairs here.
transcript.zh: 博物馆的大部分设施都在楼下地下室里，你们可以从这儿下楼。

transcript.en: When you reach the bottom of the stairs, you'll find yourself in a sitting area,
transcript.zh: 当你们走到楼梯尽头时，会发现自己置身于一个休息区域，

transcript.en: with comfortable chairs and sofas where you can have a rest before continuing your exploration of the museum.
transcript.zh: 那里有舒服的椅子和沙发，你们继续探索博物馆之前可以在那儿休息一会儿

transcript.en: We have a very good restaurant, which serves excellent food all day, in a relaxing atmosphere.
transcript.zh: 我们这儿有个很好的餐馆，全天供应美味食物，气氛非常放松。

transcript.en: To reach it, when you get to the bottom of the stairs, go straight ahead to the far side of the sitting area, then turn right into the corridor.
transcript.zh: 要去餐馆的话，当你走到楼梯底部时，直走到休息区的另一边，然后右转进入走廊。

transcript.en: You'll see the door of the restaurant facing you.
transcript.zh: 餐馆的大门就在你们面前。

transcript.en: If you just want a snack, or if you'd like to eat somewhere with facilities for children, we also have a café.
transcript.zh: 如果你们只是想吃点零食，或者想去有供孩子玩乐的设施的地方吃饭，我们还有一个咖啡厅。

transcript.en: When you reach the bottom of the stairs, you'll need to go straight ahead,
transcript.zh: 去那儿的话只要走到楼梯尽头，然后直走，

transcript.en: turn right into the corridor, and the café is immediately on the right.
transcript.zh: 右转进入走廊，咖啡厅就在你们右手边。

transcript.en: And talking about children, there are baby-changing facilities downstairs:
transcript.zh: 说到孩子，楼下有可以给孩子换尿布的地方：

transcript.en: cross the sitting area, continue straight ahead along the corridor on the left,
transcript.zh: 穿过休息区域后继续沿着左边的走廊直走，

transcript.en: and you and your baby will find the facilities on the left-hand side.
transcript.zh: 你们和孩子在左边就能看见那些设施。

transcript.en: The cloakroom, where you should leave coats, umbrellas and any large bags, is on the left hand side of the sitting area.
transcript.zh: 衣帽间，就是你们要把外套、雨伞和所有大包寄存的地方，在休息区域的左边。

transcript.en: It's through the last door before you come to the corridor.
transcript.zh: 它在到达走廊之前的最后一道门后面。

transcript.en: There are toilets on every floor, but in the basement they're the first rooms on the left when you get down there.
transcript.zh: 每一层都有卫生间，不过地下室的卫生间在下楼梯之后左边的第一间房。

transcript.en: OK, now if you've got anything to leave in the cloakroom, please do that now, and then we'll start our tour.
transcript.zh: 好了，如果你们有什么需要放在衣帽间的，请现在去放，然后我们就要开始参观了。
